Bill.BriefDescription: Reviewing the foreclosure of residential real property.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the foreclosure of residential real property;creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In an effort to reduce the number ofresidential foreclosures while protecting the interests of bothborrowers and beneficiaries, the Washington state housing financecommission shall conduct a review of the effectiveness of RCW61.24.031, which requires a beneficiary or authorized agent to contactthe borrower before issuing a notice of default for the purposes ofassessing the borrower's financial ability to repay the debt anddiscussing alternatives to foreclosure. The commission's review of theprocess shall, at a minimum, examine whether the contact requirementhas resulted in an increase in the number of loan modifications andwhether additional statutory provisions, such as mandatory mediation,are needed to produce effective communication between beneficiaries andborrowers. (2) The Washington state housing finance commission shall reportits findings and any recommendations for legislation to the appropriate p. 1 2SHB 2623committees of the legislature by November 30, 2010. (3) This section expires January 1, 2011.
